title: ULA gap.yaml — gap analysis for one unit

totalImplementedTests.description: Count of existing implemented tests targeting this unit.

ulaNotImplemented.description: ULA scenarios with NO matching existing test. MUST equal len(not-implemented).

ulaMissed.description: Existing tests no ULA scenario anticipated. MUST equal len(ula-missed).

considered-tests.description: Test source file paths actually scanned for this analysis. Empty if none found.

not-implemented.description: ULA scenarios with no matching existing test (the gaps to fill).

scenario.description: A scenario id that exists in scenarios.yaml.

note.description: One line: what behavior is left uncovered.

ula-missed.description: Existing tests whose behavior no ULA scenario describes (where ULA was weak).

test.description: Existing test name (function/case) as written in source.

file.description: Path to the file containing it. Must appear in considered-tests.

description.description: What behavior it covers that no ULA scenario describes.
